resources.title: Top 5 BEST League Start Builds | Path of Exile: Mirage 3.28
resources.creator: Big Ducks
resources.noteEs: Big Ducks resume las 5 builds más eficientes para arrancar la liga Mirage 3.28 de PoE 1: clases recomendadas, gear paths, y por qué funcionan en early/mid/late mapping. Anchor de league-start del lado PoE 1, formato compacto.
resources.noteEn: Big Ducks summarizes the 5 most efficient builds for the PoE 1 Mirage 3.28 league start: recommended classes, gear paths, and why they work across early/mid/late mapping. League-start anchor for the PoE 1 side, compact format.

resources.title: Righteous Fire Chieftain League Start Guide | PoE 1 3.28 Mirage
resources.creator: Pohx
resources.noteEs: Pohx (codex de PoE 1) presenta su league start de Righteous Fire Chieftain para Mirage 3.28. Cubre el primer día — passives priority, gear de campaña, gem links — y cómo escala hacia mapping de tier alto. Pohx es el referente histórico de RF; cualquier player que considere el archetype empieza acá.
resources.noteEn: Pohx (codex of PoE 1) presents his Righteous Fire Chieftain league start for Mirage 3.28. Covers day one — priority passives, campaign gear, gem links — and how it scales into high-tier mapping. Pohx is the historical reference for RF; any player considering the archetype starts here.

resources.title: Necromancer Dominating Blow League Start Build Guide — Path of Exile 3.28 Mirage
resources.creator: Cardboard Bastards
resources.noteEs: Build alternativa al RF de Pohx: Necromancer Dominating Blow es un archetype tanky con minions que escala hasta uber bosses. Cardboard Bastards detalla 16 minutos de league start completo — útil para players que ya jugaron RF y quieren probar algo distinto en 3.28.
resources.noteEn: Alternative build to Pohx's RF: Necromancer Dominating Blow is a tanky minion archetype that scales up to uber bosses. Cardboard Bastards details 16 minutes of complete league start — useful for players who already played RF and want to try something different in 3.28.

resources.title: Spark Archmage League Start Guide | Path of Exile 3.28 Mirage
resources.creator: Big Ducks
resources.noteEs: Spark Archmage es el caster meta del 3.28 — Big Ducks (codex) profundiza en setup específico de la build, el manejo de mana cost, las gemas auxiliares y cómo escala. Complemento a su Top 5: si te interesa el #1 de la lista, este es el deep-dive.
resources.noteEn: Spark Archmage is the 3.28 caster meta — Big Ducks (codex) goes deep on specific build setup, mana cost management, auxiliary gems, and how it scales. Complement to his Top 5: if you're interested in pick #1 from the list, this is the deep-dive.
